newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot LPGs soar in lockstep with U.S. values.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot LPGs soar in lockstep with U.S. values.

text.p: Canada spot LPG prices rose sharply Thursday in sympathy with firmer U.S. values, with Edmonton propane hitting 41 cents a gallon despite limited summer demand, traders said.
Edmonton propane was talked 40.00 to 41.00 cents a gallon, hitting values common in the winter heating season amid market concern over likely U.S. air raids on Iraq.
"The temperature is 75 degrees outside, it just doesn't make sense," one Edmonton trader said, adding that petrochemical companies were the only significant buyers in the current pricey spot market.
